settings.quantization: NF4 4-bit, double quantization; native BF16 if supported, else FP16 compute

llm_weight_revision: Not recorded in prior runs; resolve and pin before first inference without consulting outputs.
authorship: AI-authored from source review text and metadata; no generator aspect labels used; no inference or retrieval scoring performed.
label_status: AI textual judgments; human independent confirmation absent.
clean_scope: Unexecuted questions for a future frozen-generation check; created after historical results. Same known corpus, no document holdout or blind authorship. Do not use for tuning.
access_policy: Procedural seal with hashes and version control, not encryption or technical access control; do not preview/use for development.

execution_policy.after_results: No prompt/parser/retrieval/threshold/label changes; publish errors and missing calls.
execution_policy.interrupted_started_call: Record as indeterminate if no output was durably saved; never repeat automatically.
execution_policy.completed_calls: Resume may skip completed records; retain exact environment/settings/snapshot identity.
execution_policy.results_directory: reports/reserved-final-v1 (future, do not create model outputs now)

metrics_before_execution: schema first object / actual LLM calls
strict full JSON without suffix / LLM calls
IDs in context / schema-valid outputs with claims
literal excerpts / outputs with valid IDs
negative abstention / 3, split LLM versus no-LLM
factual support sustained/partial/unsupported and answers_question separately by human review
latency/tokens/allocated and reserved VRAM with hardware identity
runner_status: Reserved only. Existing final_v3 loader hardcodes n11-n20. Add input selection and one-attempt ledger later, before opening the cohort; do not change frozen core. Test with invented fixtures only.
